old_findings.note: getConfigAtId's loop still carries the slot hash (_103 = sha3(stor2, 6) / while ... < uint64(stor[_103]); 14 lines).
Struct members are still read back as slices (39 'len 8]' lines, now at mem[64] + 184 / + 248).
setExitConfig's first cast now 'revert with WM:UINT64_CAST_OOB'; upgrade's check is 'if not ext_call.return_data[0]: revert with WM:U:INVALID_SCHED_CALL'.
The return words after the join are ext_call.return_data[...] in setExitConfig and upgrade, and unscheduleCall (unknownb5ab6dee) is decoded with its arguments (P2 4 -> 3).

improvements: The 7 rotated getCurrentConfig / getCurrentCycleId loops (P3) are no longer peeled: 's = stor2 / while True: test / if not test: return | if test: s = SafeMath.dec(s); continue / break'. The checked decrement's Panic(17) is now inside SafeMath.dec, which is exact (3 explicit Panic(17) lines fewer). Dead selector, argument and return-data memory writes before named calls are gone (upgrade 93 -> 58 lines, setExitConfig 233 -> 155). Two consecutive '+ 128' pointer bumps around a loop merge into '+ 256', and a final dead bump is dropped with the later offsets adjusted (+32 -> +160), which agrees with the old addresses.
notes: Diff of 1,211 lines, read by function (9 changed). Effects are unchanged except: raw call -> unknownb5ab6dee (upgrade), Panic(17) of the checked decrement moved into SafeMath.dec (setExitConfig, unknownd326b23c, unknown1b8f1830), and one raw revert folded. The new loop form puts the test in 'while True' with if / continue / break instead of 'while s and ...' (neutral).
summary: No regression. P3 rotations removed, the raw reverts and post-join return words resolved, unscheduleCall decoded, and the dead buffer writes dropped. The slot-hash loop variable and the struct slices remain.
